title: finding(spec): `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid']` (`ObjectGridPropsSchema`) declares neither `description` nor `emptyState`, which objectui's `ObjectGrid` reads once objectui#11130 lands
body:
Filing-gate category: ① class (b), where the spec row lags the renderer. `reach:` a named consumer: objectui's `ObjectGrid`. After PR objectui#11130, it reads `schema.description` (through `resolveI18nLabel` in the display locale) and `schema.emptyState` (`{ title?, message?, icon? }`, drawn through `DataEmptyState`).

Reader: triage first (grade and route; `domain:spec` by the anchoring rule), then the spec seat. Filed by objectui's `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11130 (objectui#11068). The source is the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, confirmed in that PR's contract review (`5895665578`, ③ 3) by reading the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (read at objectstack `origin/main`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:3370`: `ObjectGridPropsSchema = lazySchema(() => strictObject({ … }))`.
  - It is a strict shape.
  - Its docblock says the key set is derived from the objectui renderers' own read points.
  - It declares `label`, `title`, `columns`, `filter`, `sort`, the pagination, search, selection and action keys, `navigation`, `data` and more.
  - It declares neither `description` nor `emptyState`.
- The same holds in the published 17.4.0 (`dist/ui/index.js`), which objectui pins.

## What it costs today (per the review)

- objectui's `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` judges `object-grid` in the FORWARD direction: "declares no top-level input the spec does not accept". So `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` cannot list `description` or `emptyState` without a tracked exemption. PR objectui#11130 leaves the inputs alone and its docs say why.
- objectui's SDUI parser reports an authored `emptyState` on `object-grid` as `unknown-prop` (a warning). `description` passes because it is in `SDUI_BASE_PROPS`.
- A metadata author validating against the spec row has `emptyState` refused by name, although the renderer honours it.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Add the two members, matching objectui's shape:
  - `description`: `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`.
  - `emptyState`: a strict `{ title?, message?, icon? }`, matching objectui's zod twin in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`.
- Then, in a follow-up objectui PR after the spec release is installable, list both in `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`, which the parity gate's REVERSE direction requires.
- objectui#11068 stays open (`Part of`) for `showFilters` / `keyboardNavigation`, which go back to triage there: no renderer machinery reads either, and the row refuses both. If a later objectui PR honours either, the same row needs it too.

## Dedupe

About 1136 objectstack issues/PRs (the 500 most recently updated, fetched now, plus the earlier cache down to #2657) were grepped for:
- `ObjectGridPropsSchema`, `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`, and `object-grid` within 80 characters of `emptyState` / `description`: 1 hit, objectstack#19514 (closed; `ViewFilterRuleSchema` / `defaultFilters`, a different key).
- `object-grid|ObjectGridProps|ComponentPropsMap`, keeping open items and anything above #20200: objectstack#20665 (open; `record:related_list.actions`) and objectstack#20471 (open; line-number-only anchors on six other rows). Neither covers these keys.
